result.summary: ISS-0153 / GH #471 resolved. LuaJIT link verdict: NOT AVAILABLE (verified empirically: @cInclude("lua.h") -> 'lua.h not found' with and without -lc; -lluajit-5.1 -> 'unable to find dynamic system library'; no lua.h/libluajit on disk; vendor/ and build.zig.zon hold only pg/http/cel; nothing in docker-compose or CI). Took the ISS-0147 disposition: replaced the unresolvable @cImport/extern-fn surface with faithful pure-Zig stubs returning FAILURE sentinels, so src/lua compiles and is type-checked without a linker while never pretending to run scripts. Fixed 8 categories of rot (issue named 2): c_void, callconv(.C), 2-arg @ptrCast, '&&', nanoTimestamp removal, {:04d} format syntax, 3 called-but-undeclared decls, and a non-compiling/leaking/double-freeing ScriptValue.deinit; plus @divExact->@divTrunc on elapsed ns. Wired via new addTest root src/lua_test_root.zig at src/ (placement forced by host_api -> ../../simulation -> ../event_store escape chain) and new `zig build test-lua` attached to the aggregate test step; reachability proven by mutation, 11 tests execute. Downgraded all 16 of LUA-01..16 RELEASED -> IN_PROGRESS since RELEASED was backed by nothing executable. Remaining half (actually linking LuaJIT) filed as ISS-0161 / GH #485 and enqueued QUEUED.
